parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ prompt: `Analyze transcript file with format handling and custom extraction.

## File: ${$json.filename}
## Format: ${$json.formatName} (.${$json.format})
## Progress: File ${$json.fileIndex} of ${$json.totalFiles}

## Format Handling
- .srt: Parse numbered sequences, extract timestamps and text
- .txt: No timestamps, focus on content
- .json: Look for Whisper/AWS Transcribe/simple formats
- .vtt: Standard WebVTT parsing

## Task
1. Read /transcripts/${$json.filename}
2. mkdir -p /transcripts/summaries
3. Create comprehensive analysis

## Content Type Detection
First, identify the content type:
- Meeting / Lecture / Podcast / Interview / Conference / Customer call / Focus group / Webinar / Other

## Standard Extraction

### Participants & Roles
- Speakers, roles, count

### Questions & Discussion
- All questions asked
- Answers given
- Unresolved items

### Key Content
- Main topics
- Key points, decisions
- Facts, figures, data
- Technical terms

### Actionable Items
- Action items with owners
- Deadlines
- Tools/resources mentioned

### Notable Moments
- Key insights
- Points of agreement/disagreement${$json.extractorInstructions}

## Output Format
Write to ${$json.outputPath}:

# [Title/Subject]

**Source**: ${$json.filename}
**Type**: [Content type]
**Format**: ${$json.formatName}
**Duration**: ~XX minutes
**Participants**: [List]

## Key Questions & Responses
[All Q&A]

## Main Topics Covered
[Topics with key points]

## Action Items & Follow-ups
- [ ] [Items]

## Tools & Resources Mentioned
[List with context]

## Notable Quotes & Insights
[Key quotes]

## Summary
[3-5 sentences]

${$json.customExtractors.map(e => `## ${e.name}\n[Extracted data for ${e.name}]\n`).join('\n')}

After writing, output only: "COMPLETE: ${$json.filename}"`, maxTurns: 15, workingDir: '/transcripts' }) }}
